summary: TSMC filed a Form 6-K reporting its monthly net revenue for June 2026, along with updates on lending, guarantees, and derivative transactions. Revenue was NT$442.68 billion for the month, up 67.9% year-over-year, and NT$2,404.48 billion for the first half, up 35.6%. The filing contains no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event. It is a routine operational and financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a domestic issuer's 8-K reporting earnings. There are no deal terms or risk-arb angles.
